note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 for the Ichkerian government; gameplay classifications, not legal citations. Religion: a Sharia-based criminal code was adopted in September 1996 and Sharia courts were established (Chechen Republic of Ichkeria article), classed as partial religious law. Elections: none were held after 1997 and the Parliament was suspended by the Supreme Islamic Court in December 1998 (same article). Wartime mobilisation and an economy disrupted by war are gameplay judgements.
